query: Help me understand the key points in this table — what should I concentrate on?

per_column.name: crew_service_quality
per_column.rationale: The demeanor and helpfulness of cabin crew (warm/attentive vs. rude/indifferent) is a core constitutive aspect OF service quality — a genuine part-of relationship, not an external predictor.

per_column.name: food_quality_assessment
per_column.rationale: Quality of food & beverages served is a standard, direct sub-dimension of the inflight service experience; it is an aspect of the concept itself.

per_column.name: proactive_service_frequency
per_column.rationale: How proactively/frequently crew deliver service is a genuine aspect of service quality, but it is a sub-dimension of crew interaction and overlaps heavily with crew_service_quality (warm_attentive vs. frequent_proactive capture nearly the same underlying dimension).

per_column.name: seat_comfort_issue
per_column.rationale: Physical seat comfort (comfortable / cramped / broken) is a well-established constitutive facet of the onboard service quality experience.

per_column.name: complaint_resolution_quality
per_column.rationale: Service recovery — how complaints are handled — is a legitimate aspect OF overall service quality, distinct from the other in-cabin facets, and adds coverage beyond the original rating columns.

per_column.name: communication_failure
per_column.rationale: Adequacy of information/communication is a recognized aspect of service quality; however as a crew-interaction dimension it partially overlaps with crew_service_quality and proactive_service_frequency, weakening exclusivity.

judge.rationale: Every added column passes the meronymy test: each is an aspect OF airline service quality (crew behavior, food, proactivity, seat comfort, complaint handling, communication) rather than an external predictor, cause, or restatement of the whole. So on the constitutive-facet criterion the set is clean (all 6 are facets). MECE is where it weakens. Mutual exclusivity is only moderate because crew_service_quality, proactive_service_frequency, and communication_failure all decompose the same crew-interaction dimension — proactivity and communication are largely sub-aspects of overall crew demeanor, so the carving is not cleanly non-overlapping. Exhaustiveness is moderate: it covers the classic service pillars of staff, food, and seat comfort and usefully adds service recovery, but it omits inflight entertainment (an explicit service dimension present in the source data) and ground/boarding/baggage service, so it does not fully cover the concept's main constitutive aspects.
